$comment: Entry point for the app and the build script. To add an exam: create data/exams/<id>.json and append one entry below. Categories drive the 'cross-category' overlap classification. Add a new category (e.g. railways) the same way.

statusLegend.official: Named in the official notification syllabus text (verbatim or near-verbatim).
statusLegend.official-umbrella: Not named itself, but clearly covered by an official heading or section name (e.g. 'Modern History' under SSC's 'History'; 'RBI' under a 'Banking Awareness' section).
statusLegend.pyq-derived: Not in any official syllabus; included because it appears regularly in previous-year papers. Editorial.
statusLegend.unverified: Uncertain or low-frequency; may or may not be asked. Verify against recent papers before investing heavily.
